request: Enforce cumulative project assurance in CI and protect release provenance.
scope: Security scans, release evidence and independent approval.
setup: Run from the PARK checkout using Python and Git.
constraints: Keep scanning read-only and scope signed release evidence to the default branch.

steps.action: Run tier-dependent checks and verify release prerequisites.
Evaluate owner review for branch pushes associated with a pull request.

verify.expected: The associated PR and pushed commit reach the existing review policy.

acceptance.entrypoint: Evaluate owner review for branch pushes associated with a pull request.
acceptance.given: Repository contract completed for a branch push with an associated PR.
acceptance.when: The trusted gate resolves the workflow and evaluates review state.
acceptance.then: It checks the pushed commit against the live PR head and enforces the review policy. Ambiguous associations and missing commit IDs fail.

acceptance.entrypoint: Run tier-dependent checks and verify release prerequisites.
acceptance.when: Run its assurance checks with synthetic scanner commands.
acceptance.then: Each required check runs for the selected tier.

acceptance.entrypoint: Run tier-dependent checks and verify release prerequisites.
acceptance.given: A required scanner fails or recovery evidence is stale.

acceptance.entrypoint: Run tier-dependent checks and verify release prerequisites.
acceptance.given: A critical project owner authors a pull request.
acceptance.then: Approval from a distinct configured reviewer is required.

acceptance.entrypoint: Verify accepted behavior in the hosted assurance job.
acceptance.given: A topic branch already contains commits covered by its handoff.
acceptance.when: Push another commit to the topic branch.
acceptance.then: Validate the complete change since the branch diverged. Default-branch updates still use the previous tip.

acceptance.entrypoint: Provision security scanners in the hosted job.
acceptance.given: The policy selects the latest stable native Semgrep release.
acceptance.when: Run the hosted installer against a controlled provider.
acceptance.then: The installer passes the latest selector to the wheel resolver and stops before extracting an archive that fails verification.
